_comment: --cms=none: lib/cms is deleted, but proxy.ts is the locale-rewrite middleware (not CMS code) and imports helpers from it — `isHomeSlug`, used to redirect /home → /, and the preview framing helpers. Inline `isHomeSlug` (a pure string check over a fixed slug list, verbatim from lib/cms/core.ts) instead of deleting the middleware, and replace the Strapi/Prepr preview framing helpers from lib/cms/preview.ts with their no-CMS answer: no editor origin, so frame-ancestors 'none'. The rest of proxy.ts's Prepr behaviour is gated on the NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_PROVIDER env var, which a no-CMS shop never sets, so it stays inert without patching.
